name.ja: 30MS 春日未来 (20th Anniv. YOU AND アイ！)
name.en: 30MS MIRAI KASUGA (20th anniversary costume "YOU AND I!")

ja: 「アイドルマスター ミリオンライブ！」より「春日未来」を30MSフォーマットで立体化！20周年記念衣装「ＹＯＵ ＡＮＤ アイ！」と全身のパーツが同梱。
■髪飾りパーツは20周年記念衣装のデザインとオリジナルデザインの2種類が付属。
■表情パーツはタンポ印刷を施した3種類が付属。口の中の色分けはパーツ分割で再現。
■衣装は髪飾りや襟元など、細部にクリアパーツを採用し、そのまま組み立てるだけでカラフルな色分けや精密なディテールを再現。
■スカートは模様をプリントしたシートで再現。
■表情付きハンドパーツに加えマイクが保持できるハンドパーツが付属。
en: "Haru Mirai " from " THE IDOLM@STER MILLION LIVE!" is now three-dimensional in 30MS format! The 20th lap commemorative costume " YOU AND I!" and whole body parts are included.
• Two types of hair ornament parts are included: a 20th anniversary costume design and an original design.
• Three types of facial expression parts with tampo printing are included. The color coding inside the mouth is reproduced by dividing the parts.
• The costume uses clear parts for details such as hair ornaments and collars, and reproduces colorful color coding and precise details just by assembling.
• The skirt is reproduced with a sheet with a pattern printed on it.
• In addition to hand parts with facial expressions, hand parts that can hold a microphone are included.

ja: フェイスパーツ(タンポ印刷)×3種
